title: The pinwheel's radius-2 law reads its own labels
subject: Whether the labels of the pinwheel's regrowth rule can be read from the unlabelled planar map on every pinwheel tiling
conclusion: On every pinwheel tiling, the radius-2 neighbourhoods of darts in the unlabelled planar map take exactly 1,168 forms, each fixing its edge's oriented label (side types, intervals, direction), so the labels that drive the eleven-label regrowth rule are read from the bare map within radius 2. The proof closes the 193 collared tiles under the cut and cuts each of the 108 complete ones four times; at radius 1 there are 198 forms, 9 of them ambiguous.
